updates.text: The site is live. The map, checklist and guides fill in from launch day.
**GTA 6 is out** on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It unlocks at midnight local time, country by country. [Release facts](/guides/gta-6-release-editions/)
Reviews are in: **Metacritic 99**, and IGN and GameSpot both gave it 10/10. That ties Ocarina of Time as the highest-rated game ever.
**No 60fps mode.** Rockstar targets 30fps on every console. PS5 Pro gets PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows. [Performance breakdown](/guides/gta-6-best-settings/)
Washed-out screenshots? That's HDR. [Here's the fix for PS5 and Xbox](/guides/gta-6-best-settings/).
**17 cheat codes confirmed**, each matching in at least two guides. All of them need the story finished first, and using one turns off saving. [Cheat list](/guides/gta-6-cheats/)
**Money guide by chapter** is up: early drug runs, Moses's car buying, $10k to $25k jewelry jobs, and vaults worth up to $205,000. [Read it](/guides/gta-6-make-money-fast/)
Bank your cash: you drop everything you're carrying when you're Busted or Wasted. BuckMe opens in the *Buck Me* mission. [Beginner tips](/guides/gta-6-first-48-hours/)
**Missable:** the four projects at Jason's house, including that hard-to-find railing, lock once you pick Lucia up in *Coming Home*. [Where the railing is](/guides/gta-6-fix-railing-jasons-house/)
**Last day** for the Vintage Vice City Pack and a free month of GTA+ with digital purchases (before Nov 20).

Full **trophy list** (55, Platinum: *Vice Got a Price!*) and **collectible counts** (480 cards, 125 cocaine flamingos) are up. [Trophies](/guides/gta-6-trophies/) · [Collectibles](/guides/gta-6-collectibles/)
Reported easter egg: climb the tallest radio tower (about six minutes) to find an egg in a nest. Throwing it off triggers a short cutscene. Spotted by a player on X, via Kotaku.
